## Business Overview

Fanny Pack Home Services is a licensed handyman and home services company serving Central Florida. The company connects homeowners and commercial clients with a vetted network of licensed, insured handyman professionals. Every professional in the network is required to carry both general liability insurance and workers compensation coverage — it is a non-negotiable requirement.

The business operates on three principles: honest quotes before any work starts, same-day response to every estimate request, and work done to the customer's satisfaction. There are no hidden fees, no minimum job size, and no job types turned away.

**Contact:**
- Phone: (904) 468-7667
- Email: hello@fannypackhs.com
- Address: 931 N. State Road 434, Suite 1201, Altamonte Springs, FL 32714
- Website: https://fannypackhomeservices.com
- Quotes: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/#quote

**Hours:**
- Monday through Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM

URL: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/drywall-repair

URL: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/tv-mounting

URL: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/services/door-repair

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Fanny Pack Home Services licensed and insured?
Yes. Every professional in our network is required to carry both general liability insurance and workers compensation coverage before they can work with us. It is a non-negotiable requirement. You are protected if anything goes wrong on the job.

### How much does Fanny Pack Home Services charge?
Pricing depends on the job. We do not quote a flat rate without knowing what the work involves. You will get a clear quote before any work starts, with no surprises on the invoice.

### Are estimates free?
Phone and virtual estimates are free. If you need a technician to come on-site to assess the job, there is an $85 on-site estimate fee. That fee is credited toward the total cost of the job if you proceed with the work.

### How quickly will I get a response to my quote request?
Same day. Every estimate request receives a same-day response.

### How soon can you schedule a job?
Most jobs can be scheduled next day. Larger or more complex work is typically within the same week.

### Is there a minimum job size?
No. There is no minimum job size. A single outlet swap gets the same honest quote as a full punch list.

### Do you guarantee your work?
Yes. We stand behind every job. If the work is not done to your satisfaction, we will make it right.

### Do you work on commercial properties?
Yes. We serve both residential homeowners and commercial clients — offices, retail spaces, property management companies, landlords, and short-term rental operators.

### Can you work around short-term rental turnover schedules?
Yes. We work with property managers and STR owners regularly. We can coordinate with cleaning crews and work within tight check-in/checkout windows.

### Is there any job type you will not do?
No. We do not turn away job types.

### Who are the technicians?
Fanny Pack Home Services works with a vetted network of professional tradespeople across Central Florida. Every professional is required to be licensed where applicable and carry both general liability and workers compensation insurance.

### What areas do you serve?
Central Florida including Orlando, Altamonte Springs, Sanford, Kissimmee, Mt. Dora, Zellwood, Longwood, Clearwater, Tampa, Lake Mary, Winter Garden, Maitland, Lake Nona, and surrounding communities.

## Blog

### Do Handymen Need a License in Florida?
URL: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/blog/florida-handyman-license

Florida does not issue a single statewide "handyman license." Instead, Florida regulates contractors by trade and project scope. A certified or registered contractor license is required for projects above certain dollar thresholds and for specific trade categories (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, structural). Permit-free handyman work — which covers most common home repairs — does not require a state contractor license, but professionals still need to carry insurance. Homeowners should always verify insurance before allowing any contractor on-site.

### Central Florida Home Maintenance Checklist
URL: https://fannypackhomeservices.com/blog/central-florida-home-maintenance-checklist

A seasonal maintenance guide covering the specific demands of Florida's climate on residential properties: humidity effects on doors and frames, exterior paint and caulk lifespan, pool maintenance calendars, lawn care schedules for St. Augustine grass, AC filter replacement intervals, and weatherstripping inspection timing.
